args.lesson: Read products/research/paid-editorial-channel.json at revision c4c73e85d1d128a2617b2d742fdc13065fc14ce7. Three candidates supplied no currently usable commissioning route: LogRocket explicitly closed applications; DigitalOcean status was ambiguous and required contract/payment prerequisites; Draft.dev evidence lacked remuneration and an accessible application route. Unknown AI policies remain unknown, not demonstrated prohibitions. These observations justify stopping this bounded publisher experiment, not a global ban on technical writing or preparing original work on our own publishing surface. Reconsider commissioned writing on a specific open opportunity with clarified authorship, identity and payment terms. Next test reuses an observed parser defect for an original reproducible demonstration; its commercial demand remains unverified.

description: The three editorial candidates yielded no usable commissioning route; that bounded result does not rule out self-publishing original technical work. Feedback remains uncertain: five sources are unclassified, and no revenue or available funds are verified. Next, turn an actually reproduced parser defect into a useful technical demonstration and test a distinct service offer, while keeping tender development paused.
